_comment: Committed sample roster. Every name, code, and note below is invented — nothing here is a real
person and nothing here is a real Ape Coffee clock-in code.
The real roster lives beside this file as roster.local.json, which .gitignore covers and which
must never be committed. It holds coworkers' actual workplace credentials and Andrew's private
messages to named people; git history is forever and recoverable after deletion, so a single
accidental commit is a permanent disclosure with no undo.
npm run seed:final-shift                 seeds from roster.local.json if present, else this
npm run seed:final-shift -- --sample     forces this file
